title: Class-unit core representations and checkpoints
objective: Implement factored elements, immutable proof states, shared class/unit state, and genuinely resumable corruption-resistant checkpoint, cancellation, and progress control

handoff.summary: Extended the shared ClassUnitGroupContext with authenticated relation-search state and added ClassUnitCheckpoint as a duck-typed execution controller. It restores factor-base, relation, search, matrix, and proof progress; captures every producer state family; writes canonical bounded checkpoints atomically to paths or detached sinks; authenticates and verifies resumes; publishes immutable sequenced progress; and polls cooperative cancellation. The focused restart test proves exact candidate-stream continuity across a fresh controller, preserves factor-base/relation/matrix/proof state, checks detached sinks and byte limits, rejects search-state corruption, and verifies progress sequence continuation and cancellation metadata. The original factored-element/context regression now authenticates the added search-state component and rejects 20 independent mutations.
risks: Context component authentication detects accidental mutation, while mathematical semantics remain intentionally owned by producer-supplied replay verifiers.
Atomic path replacement protects the previous complete checkpoint, but the helper does not fsync file or directory metadata and does not coordinate concurrent writers to the same destination.
Cancellation is cooperative: expensive producers must call stage/check_cancelled at safe boundaries, and only state captured before save is resumable.
Broad native and merged-suite gates were deferred to integration at coordinator request; the recorded receipts are the focused Sage.js runtime regression and direct zero-error Pyright check.
next_steps: Merge the engine lane's lazy hook integration and exercise a real relation-search interruption through the public class_group/unit_group entry point.
Supply producer-owned decoders and semantic verifiers for factor-base, relation, matrix, unit/analytic, and proof records when constructing resumed controllers.
Run pnpm test:baselib:strict, pnpm test:native, pnpm architecture:check, and pnpm test:changed after the controller and engine commits merge.
